blocks.text: No person shall be allowed the use of the sanitary sewers of the City without the payment of the sewage service charge, nor shall there be any discrimination among users of like classes as to rates. (Ord. 19496 § 97, 12-21-10. Code 1981 § 44-302. Code 1995 § 146-348. Formerly 14.80.840.)
